title: Isaiah's Call
hint: The prophet sees the Lord's glory
intro: Isaiah 6 describes the prophet's calling—a vision of God on His throne in the temple. The revelation exposes both God's holiness and human sin, yet also God's gracious cleansing and call to service.

items.title: In the year King Uzziah died
items.note: About 740 BC—a time of crisis in Judah

items.title: The difficult mission
items.note: Quoted by Jesus regarding the people's unbelief (Matt 13:14-15)

items.title: The holy stump
items.note: Remnant theology—the hope of a remnant

footer.title: Meeting the Holy One
footer.content: Isaiah's calling shows the pattern for all true service: first, revelation of God's holiness; then, recognition of one's own sin; next, God's cleansing; and finally, the call to service. We must see God before we can serve Him.
